$comment: XR-LAUNCH-012 (decision D7). The status checks branch protection must require on `main`. Each is one aggregate gate job (name = check context) that fails unless every job of its workflow succeeded. scripts/ci-policy.ts validates this file against the workflows; scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh prints the owner-run `gh api` command. Changing this list is an owner decision — update docs/ci/REQUIRED_CHECKS.md with it.
